subsystem: keyboard matrix primitives, key dispatch and editor state
implementation: handwritten high-level C with an optional host row-sampling callback

implemented_routines.name: matrix scan
implemented_routines.scope: first nonempty of seven ascending row selections; unchanged state on no key

implemented_routines.name: debounce
implemented_routines.scope: five samples and column intersection, timer/port writes; physical timing excluded

implemented_routines.name: held-key query
implemented_routines.scope: ten bounded samples, busy-state release and timer/port writes

implemented_routines.name: key table lookup
implemented_routines.scope: all column/row masks, highest-set-bit selection and ROM table data

implemented_routines.name: modifier/context table selection
implemented_routines.scope: only through 1dc3e, before subsequent token remapping/editor actions

implemented_routines.name: modifier token predicate
implemented_routines.scope: all token bytes

implemented_routines.name: modifier state updates
implemented_routines.scope: all tokens except EC cursor refresh, all flag bytes

implemented_routines.name: data token predicate
implemented_routines.scope: all tokens and action-context bytes

implemented_routines.name: menu token predicate
implemented_routines.scope: all tokens and action-context bytes

implemented_routines.name: direction token predicate
implemented_routines.scope: all tokens and action-context bytes

implemented_routines.name: natural-input permission
implemented_routines.scope: Math-output setting, suppression/context/mode and state branches

implemented_routines.name: normalize special action
implemented_routines.scope: original result-state action remapping

implemented_routines.name: editor/display context policies
implemented_routines.scope: special-view setup table, formula view, natural input and natural result permissions

implemented_routines.name: cursor token categories
implemented_routines.scope: all256 token/following-byte pairs

implemented_routines.name: cursor glyph and position
implemented_routines.scope: native flag normalization, byte-valued length boundary, coordinates and font capture

implemented_routines.name: complete modifier transition API
implemented_routines.scope: fx_editor_update_modifiers includes EC cursor refresh and saved temporary-state restoration

implemented_routines.name: construct-control navigation
implemented_routines.scope: native skipping and placeholder rules; infinite control-only search bounded

implemented_routines.name: ordinary-byte insertion
implemented_routines.scope: ordinary input flag, linear overwrite and natural caret/placeholder/backup rules; capacity99

implemented_routines.name: legacy-text editor actions
implemented_routines.scope: beginning/end and forward/back cursor moves, delete in insert/overwrite modes, busy-state writes

implemented_routines.name: structured natural insertion
implemented_routines.scope: all construct templates, current/previous atom wrapping, signed/scientific operands, placeholders and caret attachment, cursor field selection, backups and capacity99

implemented_routines.name: natural editor actions
implemented_routines.scope: left/right wrapping and busy state, vertical field navigation, deletion with construct shell removal, selected argument preservation and placeholder restoration

gaps: blocking key event loop and cursor blink
modifier integration with complete key-event dispatch
complete key-to-editor integration and malformed-state recovery
menus, mode setup and expression history
oracle_scope: passive F040 register, prepared native routine or bounded-block contexts; dynamic host row-sampling contract checked separately
